title: First Holy Communion 2026
description: A photo essay from the First Holy Communion Mass, Saturday 6 June 2026, at Our Lady & St. James, Bangor.

hero.alt: First Holy Communion children gathered with Fr. Savi before the high altar

headline: First Holy Communion 2026
intro: On the morning of Corpus Christi weekend, thirteen children came forward to receive the Body of Christ for the first time.

album.label: View Full Album
album.text: The full set of photographs from the day — all 400 images — is available in the parish photo album.

text: White lilies and roses adorned the sanctuary. Bread, wine, and candlelight — the simple signs of an ancient mystery.

photos.alt: The sanctuary prepared for First Holy Communion — white lilies, candles, bread and wine
photos.caption: The sanctuary prepared for First Holy Communion

text: Families filled every pew. Fr. Savi addressed the congregation before the children came forward.

photos.alt: The congregation gathered for the First Holy Communion Mass
photos.caption: The congregation gathered in the nave

text: One by one, they came forward. **Fr. Savi** placed the host in their hands for the very first time.

photos.alt: Fr. Savi with the children during the ceremony
photos.caption: Fr. Savi with the children

quote.text: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

text: Each family gathered with Fr. Savi after Mass — moments of quiet pride and shared joy.

text: The whole community — children, families, godparents, and parishioners — gathered before the altar. A day to remember.
